changes: Added barcode scanning to the Inventory search workflow for fast product price updates.
A scanned Inventory barcode now searches by barcode, opens the Edit Product dialog for a single exact match, and focuses the Selling Price field for immediate replacement.
Inventory barcode scans keep filtered results visible when multiple products match and reuse the existing Product not found notification when no match exists.
After saving a scanned product, Inventory returns to barcode scanning mode so consecutive price updates stay fast.
